name: Sky Forecast
summary: Type /forecast to learn when the rain starts or stops and whether thunder is coming, read from the weather timers the server keeps.
logoPrompt: A single puffy cloud, white on one side and dark grey on the other, with a small yellow lightning bolt and three blue rain drops falling from its dark side, centred, in blocky voxel style, no text
description: **Sky Forecast adds the command /forecast, which tells you what the weather does next and roughly when.**
- Shows whether it is clear, raining or thundering, and when the rain starts or stops, in minutes or in-game days.
- Says whether the coming rain brings thunder: for sure, possibly or not at all.
- Reads the server's own weather timers: known times to the minute, times still left to chance as a range, never a guess.
- Knows about `/weather clear`, the `doWeatherCycle` game rule and a frozen game, and says when the weather will not change.
Put the jar into the `mods` folder next to Fabric API. Type `/forecast` in chat. Every player can use it without operator rights.
- Made for Fabric on Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1 and needs Fabric API.
- Works in singleplayer and on servers. On a server only the server needs it; players can join without installing anything.
- The Nether and the End have no weather; there it shows the Overworld's forecast.
- Sleeping through the night still ends the rain early.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
